label: build release
command: ([ -f build/release/CMakeCache.txt ] || cmake -S . -B build/release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-15 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-15 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON) && cmake --build build/release --config Release --target NoorRay

label: run release
command: ([ -f build/release/CMakeCache.txt ] || cmake -S . -B build/release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-15 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-15 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON) && cmake --build build/release --config Release --target NoorRay && ./build/release/NoorRay

label: build debug
command: ([ -f build/debug/CMakeCache.txt ] || cmake -S . -B build/debug -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-15 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-15 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON) && cmake --build build/debug --config Debug --target NoorRay
